name: Cymbal Retail Operations Evaluation Suite - Multi-Turn Workflows
description: Multi-turn conversational evaluation cases for Cymbal Retail Operations Agent testing context retention, intent switching across tools, and cross-cloud loss prevention audits.

eval_cases.description: Multi-Turn Workflow: Store Operations Manager reviews low stock items, then pivots to terminal hardware printer cutter jam at checkout register.

parts.text: What are the items with under 20 cover hours remaining at Store 8?
At Store 8, SKU-9014 (Organic Whole Milk 1gal) has 14.2 hours cover remaining and SKU-4102 (Sourdough Bread Loaf) has 18.5 hours cover remaining.
Register 2 at Store 8 is also jammed with printer error ERR-DN-PRNT-24V. How do I fix the cutter blade right now?

To clear the ERR-DN-PRNT-24V cutter lock on the Diebold Nixdorf Beetle printer at Register 2: Switch off printer power, disconnect the 24V PoweredUSB cable, open the front access door, and rotate the manual thumb-wheel clockwise until the cutter blade fully retracts. Clear jammed paper fragments and reconnect the cable. (Reference: Diebold Nixdorf Beetle Guide: https://storage.cloud.google.com/da-advanced-new-module1-bucket/store_pos_manual_generic/Diebold_Nixdorf_Beetle_Guide.pdf)

eval_cases.description: UC-2.2 Multi-Turn: Comparing live Bigtable 1-hour cashier override rate against historical 7-day store average in BigQuery.

parts.text: What is Cashier CASH_1190's live 1-hour override rate right now?
Cashier CASH_1190 at Store 48 currently has a live 1-hour override rate of 14 overrides/hour and void rate of 8.4% in Cloud Bigtable.
How does that compare to the 7-day average override rate for Store 48?

Comparison for Store 48:
- Cashier CASH_1190 Live 1-Hour Rate: 14 overrides/hour (Elevated)
- Store 48 Historical 7-Day Baseline Average: 2.3 overrides/hour across all cashiers
- Deviation: Cashier CASH_1190 is operating at +508% above the store baseline, triggering an AUDIT_REQUIRED flag.
